LightningComponentBundle.description: Ask Fin through the Fin Agent API, inline on the page, with product and self-service cards from Fin Card Studio under matching answers.

property.name: headlineAccent
property.label: Headline accent line
property.description: Second headline line, shown in the accent color.

property.name: welcomeMessage
property.label: Intro text
property.default: Ask a question. Fin answers with the products, guides and next steps that fit.

property.name: suggestions
property.label: Suggested questions

property.name: cardSize
property.label: Card size
property.description: studio follows the Card size set on the Fin Card Studio Display page.
